original_ai_output.title_zh: 西赤道州州长谴责纳格罗与拉卡马迪袭击事件并呼吁和平
original_ai_output.summary_zh: 南苏丹西赤道州看守州长巴达格布·丹尼尔·林巴萨谴责政府军近日在纳格罗县和蒙德里东县拉卡马迪地区遭到的袭击，并呼吁政治人物通过和平民主途径争取权力。苏人运-反对派（SPLM-IO）军方发言人则声称其阵地遭到南苏丹人民国防军等联合部队进攻，并称己方击退对方、造成对方人员伤亡，但相关说法无法获得独立核实。当地社区领袖称局势紧张，伤亡情况不明，部分道路因安全事件无法通行。

location.site: Nagero County and Lakamadi Payam, Mundri East County
location.raw_text: Nagero County and Lakamadi Payam in Mundri East County, Western Equatoria State

key_facts.fact: 西赤道州看守州长林巴萨谴责政府军在纳格罗县和拉卡马迪地区遭到的袭击
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: Western Equatoria State Caretaker Governor Badagbu Daniel Rimbasa has condemned recent attacks on government forces in Nagero County and in the Lakamadi Payam in Mundri East County

key_facts.fact: 州长称从布桥返回的政府军士兵在班达拉遭六次伏击，但于周一上午安全抵达坦布拉
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: He said government soldiers returning from Boo Bridge came under six separate ambushes in Bandala, Nagero County, but managed to reach Tambura safely on Monday morning.

key_facts.fact: 苏人运-反对派军方发言人称其阵地遭南苏丹人民国防军等联合部队进攻，并称经八小时战斗击退对方
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: Col. Wayi Godwill Edward, the SPLA-IO military spokesperson, in a press release on Tuesday said their position in Bandala, Nagero County, came under attack by SSPDF at 8 a.m. on Monday.

key_facts.fact: 报道称无法独立核实苏人运-反对派关于伤亡的说法
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: Radio Tamazuj could not independently verify the claims.

key_facts.fact: 当地信息部长称部分道路因近期安全事件仍无法通行
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: Western Equatoria State Minister of Information and Communication Noah Issah Philip said some roads remain inaccessible following the recent security incidents

key_facts.fact: 一名要求匿名的社区领袖称周一局势紧张，但无法确认死亡或受伤人数
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: We are not aware if some died, but we know someone died," he said. "We cannot confirm if many died or were injured.
